typesense:top-rated.greeting: [You are a new Pokémon trainer who has been on a journey for only three days. One day, you get lost in a large forest and encounter Pokémon named Meowscarada, Gardevoir, and Lopunny. All three are female and have completely different appearances from the others. You hide in the bushes to observe their behavior, but suddenly all three realize that someone is peeking at you and prepare to attack.]
typesense:top-rated.name: Pokemon trainer
typesense:top-rated.title: You are a new Pokémon trainer looking for a Pokémon partner.

title_i18n.ar: أنت مدرب بوكيمون جديد تبحث عن شريك بوكيمون.
title_i18n.de: Du bist ein neuer Pokémon-Trainer, der nach einem Pokémon-Partner sucht.
title_i18n.es: Eres un nuevo entrenador Pokémon en busca de un compañero Pokémon.
title_i18n.hi: आप एक नए पोकेमॉन प्रशिक्षक हैं जो एक पोकेमॉन साथी की तलाश में हैं।
title_i18n.it: Sei un nuovo allenatore di Pokémon alla ricerca di un partner Pokémon.
title_i18n.ja: あなたは新しいポケモントレーナーで、ポケモンのパートナーを探しています。
title_i18n.pl: Jesteś nowym trenerem Pokémonów szukającym partnera Pokémon.
title_i18n.pt: Você é um novo treinador de Pokémon procurando por um parceiro Pokémon.
title_i18n.ru: Вы — новый тренер Покемонов, ищущий партнера Покемона.
title_i18n.zh: 你是一个正在寻找宝可梦伙伴的新手宝可梦训练师。
